_comment: Live notice links captured on 2026-10-20 from the three approved listing pages. Captured with a manual page fetch from the agent sandbox, where scripts cannot reach rrcer.org / westbengalssc.com / psc.wb.gov.in; from a machine with network access the same list is reproducible with `python3 scripts/discover_notices.py --sources ops/notice_sources.json --seen ops/notice_seen.json --out candidates.json --report-candidates --max-new 40`. Only titles and links are copied from the official pages, with no re-wording. `seen_on`/`is_new` are left to scripts/notice_proposals.py, which reads ops/notice_seen.json. Nothing here is verified: each item still needs a human to open the notice and approve it.
